stem: Original: Because of the heavy rain, the match was postponed.
choices: The match was delayed because it rained heavily.
The heavy rain stopped after the match.
The match was played in heavy rain.
It rained because the match was postponed.
explanation: Same cause and effect in new words. The others change the meaning.

stem: Original: Few students completed the survey.
choices: Only a small number of students filled out the survey.
A few students wrote the survey.
Most students completed the survey.
The survey had few questions.
explanation: *Few* means a small number, without suggesting most did.

stem: Original: The new policy is unlikely to reduce costs significantly.
choices: The new policy probably will not cut costs by much.
The new policy will increase costs.
The new policy will greatly reduce costs.
Costs are unlikely to be measured.
explanation: *Unlikely to reduce significantly* means probably not by much.

stem: Original: Despite its small size, the museum attracts thousands of visitors each year.
choices: Although the museum is small, many thousands of people visit it every year.
The museum is small because few people visit.
The museum is large and popular.
Thousands of visitors made the museum small.

stem: Original: Researchers have yet to find a cure for the disease.
choices: No cure for the disease has been found so far.
Researchers have found a cure.
Researchers stopped looking for a cure.
The disease cannot be cured.
explanation: *Have yet to* means it has not happened so far. It does not say it never will.

stem: Original: The author's argument rests on the assumption that people act rationally.
choices: The author's reasoning depends on the idea that people behave logically.
The author proves that people act rationally.
The author argues that people never think.
People rest when they act rationally.
explanation: *Rests on the assumption* means depends on the idea.

stem: Original: Not until the 1950s did most homes have a television.
choices: Most homes did not have a television before the 1950s.
Televisions were invented in the 1950s.
Most homes stopped watching television in the 1950s.
All homes had a television before the 1950s.
explanation: *Not until X* means it happened only at X, not earlier.

stem: Original: The experiment's results were inconclusive.
choices: The experiment did not give a clear answer.
The experiment failed to start.
The results proved the theory.
The experiment had many results.
explanation: *Inconclusive* means not leading to a firm conclusion.

stem: Original: The town's population has more than doubled since 1990.
choices: The town now has over twice as many people as in 1990.
The town has two populations.
The population fell by half after 1990.
The population was double in 1990.
explanation: *More than doubled* means now over twice the 1990 number.

stem: Original: She rarely misses a deadline.
choices: She almost always finishes work on time.
She often misses deadlines.
She never has deadlines.
She sometimes forgets her work.
